analysis.overview: A modern full-stack template using React (with Vite), Node.js (Express), and PostgreSQL, all containerized with Docker. The frontend will be available at http://localhost:3000. Key features include Frontend, Backend, Database, Containerization, Development Tools, and Quick Start.
analysis.architecture_overview:
- **Repository Purpose**: A modern full-stack template using React (with Vite), Node.js (Express), and PostgreSQL, all containerized with Docker. The frontend will be available at http://localhost:3000. Key features include Frontend, Backend, Database, Containerization, Development Tools, and Quick Start.
- **Frontend Tier**: React SPA
- **Backend Tier**: Express.js API Router
- **Database Tier**: Not detected
- **System Data Flow**: Asynchronous HTTP REST API flow: Client actions trigger router components in the React SPA frontend, which communicate via standard endpoints with the Express.js API Router backend service. The backend queries database rows and redirects responses.

code_patterns_details.description: Uses React functional hooks (useState, useEffect, useContext) for local and global state handling.
code_patterns_details.reusable_approach: Encapsulates reactive view logic inside functional components.

code_patterns_details.description: Utilizes async/await futures and non-blocking I/O operations for REST requests and database operations.
code_patterns_details.reusable_approach: Prevents event-loop blocking during network and disk operations.

code_patterns_details.description: Wraps external API communications and database sessions in try/except guards returning standard error payloads.
code_patterns_details.reusable_approach: Ensures clean status codes and structured diagnostic error messages.
